title: The Last Apprentice
text: A boy has been tending the dead forge alone for years, sweeping, oiling, banking the coals, waiting for his master to come back. He is thin as wire and his eyes are too old. He wants to show someone his work. He has made a great many blades.

options.label: The strongest arm tests his blades.

outcomes.text: It is good. He beams, and the forge feels warmer for it.

options.label: Offer him a place in the House.

outcomes.text: He packs his hammer, and looks back once.
He will wait for his master. He will always wait.

options.label: Tell him his master is dead.

outcomes.text: He lets the fire go out, and sits in the dark, and does not speak.
